findings.title: Skill-catalog walk (`iter_skills`) dereferences symlinks without escapes-package-root check, enabling traversal outside repo boundaries
findings.rationale: Retro-adjudication 2026-08-03 (release-truth Phase 3): partially real, misattributed. As worded the finding is false for `iter_skills` — its walker recursed only on Dirent.isDirectory(), which never follows a directory symlink. The CLASS is real in the same count-generator run: `_rglobSorted` (src/scripts/_lib/agent_src.ts, backing iter_commands/iter_artefacts/iter_all_sources) deliberately followed directory symlinks with no package-root confinement and no cycle guard — byte-identical at tag 9.14.0 — and the skills walk yielded symlinked SKILL.md leaves without an isFile/confinement check while root discovery dereferenced symlinked roots. Both walkers now confine every symlink to the walk root, bound cycles via a visited-realpath set, and skip broken links explicitly. Severity in practice low-to-moderate: exploitation presupposes write access to plant a symlink in the repo; impact was count corruption, a CI hang on cycles, and out-of-root reads during frontmatter parsing.
findings.verified_by: tests/scripts/symlink_confinement_walkers.test.ts (4-case battery x 2 walkers, green; asserts external targets ignored, internal allowed, loops terminate, broken links skipped)
